orders.get.sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?

carrier.get.sql: SELECT c.damaged, c.delivered FROM carrier_reports c JOIN orders o ON o.id = c.order_id WHERE c.order_id = ? AND o.tenant_id = ?

statements.sql: UPDATE orders SET refundable_cents = refundable_cents - ?, version = version + 1 WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND version = ? AND refundable_cents >= ?
INSERT INTO refunds (id, tenant_id, order_id, amount_cents, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
